children: Michael N. Intrator, a 10% owner serving as CEO and President, sold 78,552 shares of Class A common stock at $87.69 per share for a total of $6,888,224; after the transaction he directly owns 548,935 shares of Class A common stock.

Mcbee Brannin, an officer serving as Chief Development Officer, sold 56,531 shares of Class A common stock at $87.69 per share for a total of $4,957,203; following the sale Brannin directly owns 392,279 shares of Class A common stock and indirectly owns 49,800 shares via the Canis Major SM Trust and shares held of record by the reporting person’s child.

Brian M. Venturo, a director and Chief Strategy Officer, sold Class A common stock at $87.69 per share for a total reported sale amount of $5,753,867; following the transaction Venturo directly owns 302,526 shares of Class A common stock and indirectly owns 187,866 shares via family and trust holdings.
